candidateContents.tickets: Release: master candidate d62ba32e4f1df656c48e884eccbfa04cb2c156c2, version 0.0.32; includes DEV-102/DEV-103 review hardening, zero-warning gates, deterministic packaged smoke, and the slow-CI autosave timing repair.
highlights: DEV-102 now covers all six mindmap layouts through the real simple-mind-map pipeline, verifies sidecar propagation through a second Git working copy, and isolates X-structure UID memory per document instance.
DEV-103 now provides the Settings Help product-documentation entry required by ADR-0022 and uses package.json homepage as the single production docs domain source.
Vitest workers provide an isolated Node localStorage file, eliminating lib0/Node 26 ExperimentalWarning noise while preserving application warnings.

Desktop build warnings are cleared at their source: first-party mixed imports were removed, chokidar’s unused Stats binding is removed only during build, and only non-actionable zod upstream annotation noise is filtered.

Packaged smoke stabilizes toolbar tooltip discovery after layout-driven DOM replacement, isolates smoke runs from the production auto-update feed, and waits past the 1500ms autosave debounce before closing a document; 261/261 checks pass with clean logs.
